visibleTestCases.title: Milestone 1: Supervision Tree Boot
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin catch xmpp_sup:stop(), {ok, SupPid} = xmpp_sup:start_link(), Res = is_pid(SupPid) andalso is_process_alive(SupPid), xmpp_sup:stop(), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies the root supervisor boots with rest_for_one strategy and launches both workers.

visibleTestCases.title: Milestone 2: Fragmented XML Stream Framer
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies the stream parser handles packet boundaries and unpins sub-binaries with binary:copy/1.

visibleTestCases.title: Milestone 3: ETS Session Registry & Highest Priority Lookup
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin catch xmpp_session_registry:stop(), {ok, _} = xmpp_session_registry:start_link(), ok = xmpp_session_registry:register_session(<<"alice@localhost/mobile">>, 5, self()), ok = xmpp_session_registry:register_session(<<"alice@localhost/desktop">>, 10, self()), Res = xmpp_session_registry:lookup_by_jid(<<"alice@localhost">>), xmpp_session_registry:stop(), Res =:= [self()] end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies session registration and bare JID priority dispatch.

visibleTestCases.title: Milestone 4: C2S Handshake State Transitions
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, C2SPid} = xmpp_c2s_statem:start_link(#{}), {ok, wait_for_sasl, _} = xmpp_c2s_statem:feed_xml(C2SPid, <<"<stream:stream to='localhost'>">>), {ok, AuthState, _} = xmpp_c2s_statem:feed_xml(C2SPid, <<"<auth mechanism='PLAIN'>alice</auth>">>), xmpp_c2s_statem:stop(C2SPid), AuthState end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies SASL authentication advances state machine from wait_for_sasl to authenticated.

visibleTestCases.title: Milestone 5: Routing & Offline Fallback Queue
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin catch xmpp_router:stop(), {ok, _} = xmpp_router:start_link(), {queued_offline, Bare} = xmpp_router:route_stanza(<<"alice@localhost">>, <<"bob@localhost">>, <<"<message>Hi</message>">>), Count = xmpp_router:get_offline_count(<<"bob@localhost">>), xmpp_router:stop(), {Bare, Count} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies message routing falls back to the in-memory offline message store when recipient is offline.

visibleTestCases.title: Milestone 6: Chaos Monkey Supervision Resilience
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin catch xmpp_sup:stop(), {ok, _} = xmpp_sup:start_link(), Reg1 = whereis(xmpp_session_registry), exit(Reg1, kill), timer:sleep(60), Reg2 = whereis(xmpp_session_registry), xmpp_sup:stop(), Reg2 =/= undefined andalso Reg2 =/= Reg1 end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies that killing the session registry triggers rest_for_one supervisor restart of both registry and router without bringing down the root tree.
